items.title: Obtain a Hawaii General Excise Tax license for Honolulu business activity
items.description: Businesses operating in Honolulu, City and County of Honolulu, generally need a Hawaii General Excise Tax license; the license is a state registration rather than a separate general city business license.

feeDetail.note: The state Department of Taxation charges a one-time $20 registration fee on the Basic Business Application.

penalty.note: The state Department of Taxation: 5% of the unpaid tax for each month or part of a month for late filing, up to 25%, plus interest of two-thirds of one percent a month.

items.title: Obtain a Honolulu building permit when required
items.authority: City and County of Honolulu Department of Planning and Permitting
items.description: Building permits are required under Revised Ordinances of Honolulu Chapter 18 for covered construction in Honolulu, including additions; the city provides online and plan-review application paths.

feeDetail.note: The fee is set in the city's permit fee schedule and depends on the scope or valuation of the work.

penalty.note: No penalty amount for work done without a permit was found in the city's published permit pages.
